name: NOVA-MD
description: A WhatsApp bot built from scratch on Baileys — 348 commands, pairing-code login, no QR.

BOT_NAME.description: Shown on the menu and contact card

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number, country code, digits only

OWNER_NAME.description: Your name on the contact card

SESSION_ID.description: From the pairing site (SESSION & DEPLOY badge in the README) — leave blank to log in with PAIRING_NUMBER instead

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: Set this to the same number as OWNER_NUMBER to get a pairing code in the logs instead of a QR

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional — free key from aistudio.google.com enables .ai/.gpt/.gemini
